pre_pnl_method_revision: A09 required selector hash and strict completion/identity gates; no candidate performance observed before revision

impact_sensitivity.formula: current adverse rate + 0.001*sqrt(pre-fill notional/(0.01*previous closed-hour quote volume))
impact_sensitivity.sell_notional: owned rounded quantity * execution reference open before impact
impact_sensitivity.proxy_limit: USDT historical proxy quote turnover is not historical USDC orderbook depth
impact_sensitivity.missing_volume_or_rate_ge_one: case UNASSESSABLE, no cheap fallback, not eligible
impact_sensitivity.eligibility: fully assessable; paired ending equity >= baseline and DD <= baseline

daily5_definition.basis: native UTC-day start equity; realized plus unrealized PnL, fees and dust
daily5_definition.threshold: closed equity <= 0.95*day start equity; first such close per UTC day
daily5_definition.execution: queue all owned SELLs at next executable open, preserve earlier regular exits
daily5_definition.latch: daily5_flat until next UTC day; daily5_flat24 until max(next UTC day,trigger+24h)
daily5_definition.unresolved_owned_exits: continue blocking buys and re-queue exits after pause expiry

dd_step_definition: new entries only: normal fraction below10%peakDD; .75 at10..20%; .50 at>=20%; existing ATR fraction multiplies, no forced rebalance
cooldown_definition: aggregate net realized cycle PnL incl partial exits; after final sale, losing coin blocked24h; check again after same-boundary exits
liquidity_definition: BUY budget capped at5% previous closed-hour quote turnover; never cap or silently block liquidation SELLs
cmo_definition: Core entry floor=max(previous floor,.20); preserve stricter floors and all other policy rules

technical_gates: complete reproducible native overlay baseline parity
selection.economic_gates: ending equity >= baseline AND max DD <= baseline, separately in EACH of current,stress,impact
selection.ranking: highest current-cost net PnL first, then smaller current-cost DD, then fixed candidate order
selection.winner_only_robustness: 12 already existing five-year validation paths, baseline vs selected winner, current and stress costs
selection.robustness_gates: median paired net advantage>=0 under BOTH costs; >=7/12 normal nonworse; worst DD <= baseline under BOTH costs

interpretation: known historical data; no truly unseen out-of-sample claim
24 predeclared three-year cases plus native original controls
all15 markets/roles, one shared starting capital, reinvested PnL
open ending positions marked, no assumed final sale
no actual historical orderbooks, outages, delistings or USDC depeg model
promotion: only after winner passes historical and robustness gates plus complete same-head Backtest/Paper/Trial/Live parity, regression, A09 and A11 review; no Live activation by this research
